basic_info.description: Probate Court Hearing is set for 10/21/24 at 9am. Charming Victorian cottage within one block of the McLaren Park. This semi-detached home is situated on an extra deep lot. The main floor-plan includes both formal living and dining rooms with coved ceilings. The living room has a brick wood burning fireplace and softwood flooring. Completing this level is a kitchen which accesses a laundry porch, a full bedroom and full bath. This entry level residence has high ceilings and vintage period details. Excellent value and is awaiting your vision and inspired restoration. Completing this home is a spacious garage with parking & storage. Generous sized yard is mostly level and enjoys the Excelsior/Mission microclimate. Conveniently located near both Geneva & Mission Street shops, parks, MUNI & BART and easy freeway access. Unusually good opportunity at an exceptional price. COME SEE QUICK!!!
